## Two artifacts (**FACT** — do not conflate)

| Artifact | Role |
|----------|------|
| **Short form write-up** | Mandatory submission field: problem, build, where AWS fits; list AI tools ([tour rules](https://www.wemakedevs.org/aws/env/rules)) |
| **Builder Center article** | Side prize: Top 5 blogs → AirPods; publish on [builder.aws.com](https://builder.aws.com/); **link the article URL in the form** ([env overview](https://www.wemakedevs.org/aws/env)) |

The short form is not the AirPods entry. Pasting the short form verbatim into Builder Center is an anti-pattern (**DERIVED**).

---

## Publish where / how (**FACT**)

Sources: [Your Guide to Builder Center](https://builder.aws.com/content/2zcHXEQEQkxFslPN4dT0Qm2CSJA/your-guide-to-builder-center) · [Create article](https://builder.aws.com/create/content)

1. Sign in with AWS Builder ID; claim alias / profile. Tour rules: Builder Center profile + university enrollment verify (SheerID) — can submit while pending; rewards wait on verify.
2. Top nav **+** → **Create article** (`https://builder.aws.com/create/content`).
3. Fill required fields (draft auto-saves). Clear H1→H2→H3; short paragraphs; bullets; **alt text** on images; ≤**5** tags.
4. **Preview** → **Publish** → wait for automated moderation → confirm public URL.
5. Open URL **signed out**; paste that URL into the hackathon submission form.
6. Edit in place if needed (do not orphan the linked URL).

Suggested tags for DisputePoint (≤5): `Hackathon`, `Environmental Hacks`, `Serverless`, `DynamoDB`, `AWS`.

---

## Win patterns (**DERIVED** from strong Builder Center / hackathon posts)

1. Open with a **named human failure**, not a service catalog — DM cell + ownership confusion under monsoon.
2. Crisp reproducible flow: queue → rain → CONFLICT→null → evidence → HITL → audit.
3. Every AWS service earns a **one-line role** + simple request/event diagram (boring, deployable Ship It).
4. One **what fought back** beat: symptom → root cause → fix → proof (test or screenshot).
5. Proof surfaces: public repo, Ship It URL, screenshots (queue, CONFLICT null, Dynamo/CloudWatch if shown), ≤3 min video.
6. Honest hackathon limits; no “production-ready” overclaim.

Example posts (structure, not product copy): First Commit Beacon journey; CounterFlow “succeeded still means wrong”; Agents-for-Humans HITL boundaries.

---

## Anti-patterns (**reject**)

- Citizen-inbox / flood-heatmap product drift (Phase 6 hard stop).
- Claiming DisputePoint always assigns an owner (**CONFLICT → `responsible_agency` null**).
- “We used AWS” with no deployed path / no video proof (rules: AWS must show in demo).
- Architecture tourism (long inventory, no contract).
- Invented death counts or unmarked synthetic-as-real.
- Burning Thursday morning on the blog before WP-00 / golden path.

## Must-follow checklist (blog prize)

- [ ] Heat and Water framed as DM disputed waterlogging under rain (not generic “environment app”)
- [ ] Builder Center article ≥ readable build story (not short-form paste)
- [ ] CONFLICT→null + HITL stated explicitly
- [ ] Ship It services named with roles: API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, EventBridge, CloudWatch
- [ ] Repo + YouTube + Ship It URL linked; Cursor listed
- [ ] Preview / moderation / signed-out URL check
- [ ] Article URL pasted into submission form
